Rooms.Name: City Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You are at the entrance to a small underground city. A great adamantite gate
lies open to the west allowing entrance into the city.

Exits.Description: A huge gate opens to the west allowing entrance into the city.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A large adamantite gate with giant spider shaped emblems stands here.

Rooms.Name: City street
Rooms.Description:
You walk along a highly ornate street going north-south. A large gate lies
to the east while a building lies to the west.

Rooms.Name: City street
Rooms.Description: You walk along a highly ornate city street going north and west.

Rooms.Name: City street
Rooms.Description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going east-west. A large house
stands to the south.

Rooms.Name: 3rd House
Rooms.Description:
You stand inside the 3rd house of the city; it is fairly well decorated by
drow standards having a few statues, murals and such. A door leads to the
south.

Rooms.Name: Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
The throne room of the 3rd house is about as decorated as the inner
courtyard except with a blood covered altar in the center of the room.

Rooms.Name: City street
Rooms.Description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going east-west. To the north is
a large building.

Rooms.Name: City street
Rooms.Description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street leading north and east. To the
south is an extremely large house.

Rooms.Name: 2nd House
Rooms.Description:
You stand inside the 2nd house of the city. The room is highly decorated
with statues of spiders and murals everywhere.

Rooms.Name: Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
The throne room of the 2nd house is just a little more decorative than the
inner courtyard having an altar in the center of the room.

Rooms.Name: Main Gate
Rooms.Description:
You are at the entrance to the 1st house of the city. A large gate, almost
as big and elegant as the one at the entrance to the city, stands here.

Exits.Description: A large gate lies to the west.

Rooms.Name: 1st House
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the inner courtyard of the 1st and largest house in the city.
The room is extremely large and decorative. Mural and paintings hang on the
walls depicting some battles and a spider queen.

Rooms.Name: Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
The throne room of the 1st house is in one word... awesome. It is so
horrifying it is almost beautiful.

Rooms.Name: Main Chamber
Rooms.Description:
This is the council chamber for the Matron Mother herself. A huge table and
chairs surrounding it sits in the center of the room.

Rooms.Name: City street
Rooms.Description: You walk along a highly ornate city street leading north-south and east.

Rooms.Name: City street
Rooms.Description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street leading south. A building is to
the west.

Rooms.Name: Cleric Academy
Rooms.Description: This is the most lavish of the academies being that it is for the clerics.

Rooms.Name: City street
Rooms.Description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going east-west. To the north is
a giant temple.

Exits.Description: The entrance to the temple of Lloth.

Rooms.Name: Warrior's Academy
Rooms.Description: This looks more like a barracks than a school.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Temple of Lloth
Rooms.Description:
The temple is the largest building in the city. Even it's doors are beyond
imagination. Inside of the temple entrance, the walls are made of gold and
adamantite.

Rooms.Name: Mage's Academy
Rooms.Description:
The Mage's Academy is fairly well decorated see that the drow prefer magic
over physical power greatly.

Rooms.Name: City street
Rooms.Description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street going eastward. To the north is a
building.

Rooms.Name: Slave Chamber
Rooms.Description:
The room is in shambles. Straw is strewn all about the room as beds for the
unfortunate creatures who have fallen prey to drow imperialism.

Rooms.Name: City street
Rooms.Description:
You walk along a highly ornate city street leading west and south. To the
north is a relatively small house.

Rooms.Name: 4th house
Rooms.Description:
You stand inside the 4th house of the city. Its inner courtyard is rather
dull by drow standards and rather small as well.

Rooms.Name: Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
The throne room is basically similar to the inner courtyard in regards to
decor. there is a small throne behind the altar but that is about it.

Rooms.Name: Entrance Way
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the entrance way to the temple which opens up to the north into
a large hallway going east and west. Small statues of spiders line the entrance
way's walls.

Rooms.Name: Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved with
pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you look
down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you. To
the north is a obsidian stairway.

Rooms.Name: Long Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved with
pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you look
down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you.

Rooms.Name: Long Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved with
pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you look
down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you. To
the north is a door.

Rooms.Name: Long Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved with
pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you look
down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you.

Rooms.Name: Long Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved with
pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you look
down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you.

Rooms.Name: Long Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved with
pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you look
down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you. To
the south is a door.

Rooms.Name: Warrior's Barracks
Rooms.Description:
The room is a complete mess. None of the beds are made, clothes and other
items have been left all about the room. Well drow warriors never were known
for neatness.

Rooms.Name: Long Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are in a long hallway lined with adamantite. The walls are engraved with
pictures of elves and spiders. The hallway continues east and west. As you look
down the hallway you can make out one or two figures moving away from you.

Rooms.Name: Grand Stairway
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the bottom of a giant obsidian and adamantite stairway.
The edges are trimmed with gold.

Rooms.Name: Grand Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the middle of a grand hallway. The walls are of the
purest adamantite with gold trim. Mosaics line the walls.

Rooms.Name: Mage's Barracks
Rooms.Description:
The mage's living quarters is rather clean with the exception of a few used
component containers. It is rather well decorated as well. Cots line the floor
for the mages to sleep on. the only door is to the west.

Rooms.Name: Grand Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are walking down a grand hallway, heavily decorated with adamantite and
gold. To the north the hall goes down a flight of stairs while a door is too
the west.

Rooms.Name: Cleric's Barracks
Rooms.Description:
The bed chamber is brightly decorated with spider shaped statues, murals and
the like. Large beds line the floor making this a comfortable room to live in.

Rooms.Name: Grand Stairway
Rooms.Description:
You are climbing a set of obsidian stairs surrounded by adamantite walls. To
the north are a set of large golden doors.

Rooms.Name: Main Chamber
Rooms.Description:
This is the south side of a large auditorium used for services by the drow
priestesses. In the center is a large sacrificial pit and beyond that is an
altar.

Rooms.Name: Eastern Side of Chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are on the eastern side of the chamber overlooking the pit. To the east
is a door while to the north is an altar.

Rooms.Name: Sacrificial Pit
Rooms.Description:
A you climb down into the pit, thousands of spiders cover you, tearing your
fragile body to shreds. Lloth thanks you for your sacrifice.

Rooms.Name: Western Side of Chamber
Rooms.Description:
You are on the western side of the main chamber overlooking a sacrificial
pit. To the north is an altar.

Rooms.Name: The Altar
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in front of a highly and freshly bloodstained altar.
Engraved on the top of the altar is a giant spider with a human head. Looking
down from the altar you see a large sacrificial pit with thousands of swarming
spiders looking for their next meal!

Rooms.Name: Slave Cells
Rooms.Description:
This is the main room to the cell chambers for the slaves to be sacrificed.
You notice there are no guards around.

Rooms.Name: Slave Pen
Rooms.Description:
Rotten meat and breads lie about the floor while shackles hang from the
walls. The room reeks of death. You almost become nauseous and decide to leave
the room since you were obviously too late to save the slave.

Rooms.Name: Dias
Rooms.Description:
You stand upon a dias behind the altar. Above you is a enormous illusion of
a female drow turning into a giant spider and back again. There is a door to
the west.

Rooms.Name: The Treasury
Rooms.Description:
This is obviously only a temporary storage place for the collected treasure
being rather bare.

Rooms.Name: Weaponsmaster's Chamber
Rooms.Description:
This one person bedchamber is very elegant. The owner must be held in
high regard to get this kind of treatment. 
§N

Mobs.Name: goblin slave
Mobs.LongDescription: A goblin slave lies here asleep.
Mobs.Description: The defenseless goblin begs for mercy.

Mobs.Name: Drow commoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow commoner is here, walking around on guard duty.
Mobs.Description: I doubt he is the type to give directions.

Mobs.Name: drow noble warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow warrior noble stands here guarding his home.

Mobs.Name: drow noble mage
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow mage noble is here protecting his home.
Mobs.Description: The mage prepares to cast a spell...at you!!

Mobs.Name: drow priestess
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow priestess is here shouting orders.
Mobs.Description: I wouldn't want go get on her bad side!

Mobs.Name: drow master
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow master stares at you angrily.
Mobs.Description: The drow master is ALWAYS ready for a fight.

Mobs.Name: drow weaponsmaster
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow weaponsmaster is here shadow boxing.
Mobs.Description: He definitely know his way around in combat.

Mobs.Name: drow matron mother
Mobs.LongDescription: The Matron Mother of the house is standing here.

Mobs.Name: drow matron mother
Mobs.LongDescription: The Matron Mother of the first house is waiting for you.
Mobs.Description: She looks like she is about to rip your head of and eat it.

Mobs.Name: yochlol
Mobs.LongDescription: A yochlol forms out of a swirling mist...
Mobs.Description: The yochlol is not in a good mood.

Objects.Name: longsword commoner
Objects.Description: A commoner's longsword made of adamantite has been left here.

Objects.Name: longsword noble
Objects.Description: A drow noble's longsword, made of adamantite, lies here.

Objects.Name: whip snake twoheaded
Objects.Description: A whip with two snakes heads lies here.

Objects.Name: whip snake threeheaded
Objects.Description: A whip with three snake heads has been left here.

Objects.Name: whip snake fourheaded
Objects.Description: A whip with four snake heads has been carelessly left here.

Objects.Name: longsword black
Objects.Description: A black longsword has been carelessly left here.

Objects.Name: whip snake fiveheaded
Objects.Description: A whip with 5 snake heads has been carelessly dropped here.

Objects.Name: whip snake sixheaded
Objects.Description: A whip with six snake heads has been dropped here very carelessly.

Objects.Name: bracers iron
Objects.Description: A pair of bracers has been dropped here.

Objects.Name: gauntlets strength
Objects.Description: A pair of gauntlets is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: wand lightning blue silver
Objects.Description: A silvery blue wand has been dropped in the dirt.

Objects.Name: helmet helm
Objects.Description: A small helmet lies up against a rock.

Objects.Name: ring ruby
Objects.Description: A small ruby ring lies in the dirt.

Objects.Name: dagger sacrificial spidag
Objects.Description: A dagger with spider leg shaped blades lies on the ground.

Objects.Name: hat green
Objects.Description: A small bright green hat lies in the dirt.
